plugins.name: phased-execution
plugins.description: Run large work as a dependency graph of right-sized Claude sessions — plans, per-phase handoffs, and a computed ready-set. Ships a zero-dependency local web console: scope-aware concurrency so disjoint plans run at once while intersecting phases queue, per-session tabs, remaining-time estimates, a plan-mode wizard that drafts a plan before writing it, and Tailscale onboarding to drive it all from your phone.
